_note: David Ian Xtravaganza - facts (28 Nov 2026). Sources: Discogs artist 283540 (https://www.discogs.com/artist/283540-David-Ian, profile: 'Member of the House of Xtravaganza. AKA David Ian Xtravaganza.'), Discogs release credits for Elements of Vogue; YouTube uploads of the record. NB Discogs mixes him with a jazz pianist also called David Ian (the Christmas albums are not him).
house: Member of the House of Xtravaganza.
record: Elements of Vogue (1989), 12-inch on Extravaganza Records - mixes by David DePino and Johnny Dynell; Elements of Reprise on the B-side. Follow-up: Love's Gonna Get You (1991).
recent: Guest vocal on Johnny Dynell's 'Marie Montana (feat. David Ian Xtravaganza)' (remixes by Sveta & Tokoloshe, Runway Xtravaganza Mix).
in_the_episodes: Luis Xtravaganza Camacho remembers dancing with him from the Sound Factory to the Choice and back (S01E08, 00:19:42).
